extracted.intended_audience: Journalists and others who report on or study religion (public, nonprofits, governments, academics)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for journalists and others to understand and report on religion and belief in the U.S. and worldwide, emphasizing accuracy, balance, insight, and religious literacy. The page describes RNF's resources (stylebook, trainings, newsletters) to help produce responsible religion coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance in reporting on religion
rubrics_metrics.description: Report on religion and belief with balance, accuracy, and insight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RNF offers tools and resources to help journalists and others think about and report on religion and belief with balance. Resources include newsletters, podcasts, print publications, case studies, style guides, and trainings to promote balanced coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy in reporting on religion
rubrics_metrics.description: Report on religion and belief with balance, accuracy, and insight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RNF provides resources and training aimed at improving factual accuracy in religion coverage (e.g., a Religion Stylebook defining religious terms). Accuracy is emphasized alongside balance and insight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insightful reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Report on religion and belief with balance, accuracy, and insight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RNF's materials are intended to help reporters add context and insight to stories about religion — through case studies, print publications, and trainings that deepen understanding of how religion shapes the world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase religious literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen the public's and professionals' understanding of religion ("INCREASE religious literacy").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RNF invites individuals and organizations to join efforts to strengthen understanding of religion. Resources and trainings are offered to raise religious literacy among journalists, public officials, nonprofits, academics, and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage civil discourse
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of RNF's mission is to encourage civil discourse; their programs and resources are positioned to foster respectful, informed discussion about religion and belief in public life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use consistent, defined terminology (Religion Stylebook)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use RNF's Religion Stylebook and its defined religion terms when reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site notes 'Religion terms defined in RNF’s Religion Stylebook' and promotes style guides as a tool to ensure consistent usage of religious terminology and concepts across reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage RNF-curated resources and trainings
rubrics_metrics.description: Use RNF's curated resources (newsletters, podcasts, print publications, case studies, style guides, trainings) to improve religion reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RNF curates and frequently updates a collection of resources aimed at helping journalists report with balance, accuracy, and insight; the page invites users to explore these resources and attend RNF events and trainings.
